visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short black hair, wearing a dark blue quilted winter jacket and gray trousers, is seen jumping and spinning playfully on a light-colored wooden-style tiled floor inside a bright arcade. Behind him, blurry figures of other patrons walk by, and the room is illuminated by even, bright indoor lighting. The camera focuses on the boy as a man in a green Adidas jacket with a red inner shirt enters the frame. (2) The scene transitions to a medium shot of a claw machine filled with rows of bottled milk tea drinks. The boy's small hands are seen pressing a yellow joystick and pink buttons on a colorful control panel. The claw descends toward the bottles but fails to grip one. Yellow and white captions appear at the bottom of the screen to indicate the progress of the game. (3) The boy moves to another machine filled with stacks of white ceramic bowls. He operates the controls while the man in the green jacket stands next to him, holding a small green plastic basket. The metal claw descends and successfully hooks two bowls simultaneously, lifting them into the air. The boy looks up with wide eyes and an open mouth, showing excitement. (4) The man takes over the controls for the bowl machine. He is seen concentrating, wearing glasses, and successfully maneuvering the claw to grab three bowls at once. The camera captures the bowls falling into the prize chute. In the final scene, the man holds a large stack of about six bowls while the boy holds a stack of three, both looking proud in front of the colorful neon-lit machines.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful pop BGM featuring a steady electronic beat. A man's voice speaks in a friendly, high-arousal tone, accompanied by the background hum of an arcade. A child's voice chirps in briefly. The sound of footsteps on tile is faintly audible. (2) A sharp mechanical 'click' marks the boy pressing a button. This is followed by the whirring sound of a motorized claw mechanism. The man's voice narrates the action with quick, energetic speech, and the BGM maintains a consistent, upbeat tempo. (3) A loud 'clink' of ceramic hitting ceramic occurs as the claw grabs two bowls. The man lets out a loud, surprised 'Oh!' with a rising pitch contour. Multiple smaller clinking sounds follow as the bowls settle. The BGM beat remains dominant in the background. (4) A heavy 'thud' and a sequence of rapid ceramic clatters indicate several bowls falling into the prize chute. The man's voice increases in volume and excitement, shouting success. The BGM concludes with a final electronic flourish as the two male voices compare their 'winnings' with high-energy laughter.
